findings.claim: Agent.Index and AgentCreationResult.Index are Int32. AgentHelper.GetAgentIndex directly reads a native int32 via ldind.i4; the native pool free-index table being int16 does not make the Agent object index int16.
findings.patchRequirement: Preserve int32 native object field representation and the existing managed ABI. Do not widen the object index or change struct layout merely because pool bookkeeping uses short indices.

findings.claim: Agent constructor retains 13 native pointers in fields at IL_0078 through IL_0108, calls IMBAgent.SetMonoObject at IL_0130, and AgentHelper dereferences those pointers directly. All stores found to these fields across scanned assemblies belong to Agent constructor or Agent.Clear; no relocation refresh method was found by this direct-field-reference scan.
findings.patchRequirement: Choose final pool storage before first Mission/Agent construction, keep addresses stable through deletion, and retain SetMonoObject reverse links. Reject live pool relocation; runtime patch removal must wait until all modified-layout missions are destroyed.
